assignments.title: Theology 7 - 5: Reflection 1 (1)
assignments.description: You will write this reflection on paper in your class notebook. You will take a picture of it and submit it to myBelen.  This unit has been about what a good life is, what morality is actually for, and what our choices are making us. Now look at your own life as a 7th grader. Where do you notice these things in your own life? How do you think about the good life? What areas of your life do you struggle with vice or need to grow in virtue?  Write about 100 words. Do these three things.  Reflect on your life using the bolded prompt above. In your response, be sure to use three of the following words (the good life · morality · final end · union with God · virtue · vice · sin · freedom) Be honest. Think deeply. This is for you.    How I grade it — three things, 4 points each. 12 points total.       4 3 2 1–0     Your own life Answers the prompt with something specific from your actual life. I could picture it. Real, but stays general — no example I could point to. Mostly about people in general, or about the class instead of you. Doesn't answer the prompt.   The three words Three or more, used correctly, and they fit what you're describing. Three words, but one is used loosely. Only two, or two used correctly. Fewer than two, or used wrong.   Depth Takes one of the three questions seriously and thinks it through. Answers, and adds a reason or an example. Names something and stops. One or two lines, or clearly rushed.     You are not graded on how good your week was, or on how holy you sound. Only I read these.
